items.title: Validate immutable audit evidence content
items.complexityRationale: Requires schema integration, semantic checks, and adversarial fixtures.
implementationSteps: Invoke the audit-evidence schema during findings validation.
Enforce scanner freshness, required scope, helper validity, hosted status, and standards-profile semantics.
Add correctly hashed malformed snapshot fixtures.
verification: Run focused audit assurance and execution tests.
items.rollout: Version contracts, update producers and templates, then validate current and historical fixtures.
items.rollback: Revert schema, producer, validator, and fixture changes as one unit.
items.approvalReason: Modifies the governed audit-code skill and contract surfaces.
items.residualRisk: Historical artifacts remain readable under their original schema versions.

items.title: Canonicalize and contain audit artifact paths
items.complexityRationale: Requires command contract changes and cross-platform symlink fixtures.

Canonicalize artifact and parent paths and reject symlinks and non-regular files.
Add Windows, Linux, and macOS boundary fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Outside-root and redirected paths fail closed.
Normal repository paths pass on supported platforms.
